_provenance: awslabs.aws-dataprocessing-mcp-server@0.2.2 (PyPI, uploaded 2026-09-22). NOT a live recording: no AWS account was available when this was written (2026-10-07). Derived from that exact version's published sdist (handlers/glue/glue_etl_handler.py, crawler_handler.py, data_catalog_handler.py) and from how mcp 2.0.0's func_metadata renders a signature; pydantic `title` keys are left out. `operation` is a free string in the schema; the allowed values live only in the handlers' code and are listed in each description. PARTIAL: the server registers many more tools (EMR, Athena, other Glue resources …); only the three the routes use are listed here. Re-record with a live `tools/list` when an operator profile is available.

tools.name: manage_aws_glue_jobs
tools.description: Manage AWS Glue ETL jobs and job runs with both read and write operations.

tools.name: manage_aws_glue_crawlers
tools.description: Manage AWS Glue crawlers to discover and catalog data sources.

operation.description: create-crawler, delete-crawler, get-crawler, get-crawlers, start-crawler, stop-crawler, batch-get-crawlers, list-crawlers, update-crawler

tools.name: manage_aws_glue_tables
tools.description: Manage AWS Glue Data Catalog tables with both read and write operations.
